summary: Iteration 72 - Verified natural sound restoration in Mantras and PracticeTimer. ALL TESTS PASSED. Persistence via localStorage key 'preferred-natural-sound' works across dialog close/reopen and page reload. Play/pause/reset controls work correctly with no regressions.
